name: Odometer Hero Price
tags: hero price odometer rolling digits ticker large flash
note: Each digit is a vertical strip translated by digit height, so only changed digits roll — the rest stay perfectly still.

name: Hero Odometer Ticker
note: Oversized last-price hero. Each digit is an odometer reel that rolls with a right-to-left stagger on every tick; the whole figure flashes green or red for the direction of the print while the change chip re-signs itself.
html:
NVDA NASDAQ · LAST LIVE
$ .
▲ +2.41 (+1.32%) VOL 41.2M

name: Flash-On-Change Quote Tile
note: Classic trading-desk tile. Every print flashes the price row green or red, flips the arrow, swaps the lot size and pushes a fresh coloured bar onto the eight-slot tick tape below.
html:
AAPL Apple Inc. NSDQ
▲ 232.18 ×300
▲ +1.86  +0.81%

name: Multi-Timeframe Return Grid
note: Five horizons as diverging bars off a shared zero axis, each growing outward on a staggered spring. Every row is a real button: click or focus and Enter toggles that figure between percent and dollars.
html: MSFT click a row: % ⇆ $

name: Price With Inline Sparkline
note: Intraday sparkline drawn with a stroke-dashoffset reveal, a soft area wash and a pulsing head dot. New prints shift the series left and the whole chart re-tints if the day flips sign.
html:
TSLA 1D · 5m
418.62 ▼ −6.14 (−1.45%)

name: Bid / Ask Spread Widget
note: Level-1 quote: bid and ask flank a centre spread capsule that also prints the spread in basis points. Sizes tick live, the touched side flashes, and the split meter rebalances toward the heavier book with a signed imbalance figure.
html:

BID 612.44 1,240
0.02 SPREAD 0.3 bps
ASK 612.46 890
▲ +16.4% bid-side MID 612.450

name: 52-Week Range Scrubber
note: The last price springs into its slot on the 52-week band with a back-out overshoot. A real range input lets you scrub the band to read the price at any percentile — arrow keys included — then it eases back to the live print.
html:

168.05
LOW76.48 ▲ 68% of range HIGH211.38

name: Pre-Market / After-Hours Split
note: Two extended-hours panels either side of the regular close, over a three-band session timeline with a creeping now-cursor. The panels are real toggle buttons that lift on select and switch which band the timeline lights up.
html:
META CLOSE 742.60
04:00–09:30 ET · 1.42M shares · 214 prints

name: Price Alert Threshold Badge
note: A dash-offset ring closes as the last price creeps toward the trigger while the gap counter eases down digit by digit. Crossing the level flips the badge to a pulsing TRIGGERED state; the arm button is a real toggle that greys the ring out.
html:
